questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
Match the reactions in Column I with nature of the reactions/type of the products in Column II. Indicate your answer by darkening the appropriate bubbles of the 4 4 matrix given in the ORS.

Column I Column II
(A) (P) redox reaction
(B) (Q) one of the products has trigonal planar structure
(C) (R) dimeric bridged tetrahedral metal ion
(D) (S) disproportionation
